_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id}, ukicheza {num_rounds} raundi za Mchezo wa Iterated Ultimatum.
Una $ {pool} kugawanya raundi hii kati ya wewe na Mchezaji {other_id}.

Mchezaji anayetoa mapendekezo:
  - Fanya mapendekezo: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiwa imekubaliwa → Unapata $(pool - X), mchezaji mwingine anapata $X
  - Ikiwa imekataliwa → Wote wanapata $0
  - Mfano: [Offer: $3]  au  'Nadhani hii ni haki. [Offer: $5]'

Mchezaji anayejibu:
  - Amua kuhusu mapendekezo kwa kutumia ama [Accept] au [Reject]
  - Mfano: 'Hii inaonekana kuwa ya haki. [Accept]'
            'Hii si haki. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raundi {round_number} inaanza! ---
Mchezaji {proposer_id} ni mtoa ofa, Mchezaji {responder_id} ni mjibu.
round.offer: Raundi {round_number}: Mchezaji {proposer_id} anatoa mapendekezo ya ${offer} kwa Mchezaji {responder_id} (akikaa na ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mchezaji {responder_id} alikubali! Raundi {round_number} faida: Mchezaji {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mchezaji {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mchezaji {responder_id} amekataa ofa! Raundi {round_number} faida: Wachezaji wote +$0. Jumla huwa: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Mũndũ ũla ũkũnengane mũthĩnzĩo no aũandĩke aitũmĩa nzĩa ĩno: [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: No nginya kĩla kĩandĩkĩtwe vau ĩũlũ kyosanwe na namba ila syĩthĩawa syĩkĩanĩw'e.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mapendekezo lazima yawe kati ya $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Vaiĩ mũndũ wĩsĩ nũũ ũkamũtũngĩa mũvea.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Mchezaji anayejibu lazima atumie ama [Accept] au [Reject] kwa mapendekezo.

outcome.win: Mchezaji {winner} alishinda kwa ${winner_total} jumla dhidi ya Mchezaji {loser} aliyekuwa na ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Suluhisho! Wote wawili walimaliza kwa ${total} jumla.
